text:
ryan: hey all :wave: first day — trying to run the starter repo pipeline but the Buildkite job fails early. who should I ping for CI perms?

olivia: welcome! i'll help. can you paste the short error you see?

ryan: sure — here's the tail of the agent logs:
```
Agent: starting job 8573
Pulling docker image docker.pkg.github.com/redwood-infra/starter/base:latest
ERROR: received 403 when pulling image: denied: requested access to the resource is denied
Buildkite: job aborted
```

sam: ok that looks like a registry auth issue (GHCR/GH Packages). two quick checks: are you actually a member of the org's package team? and is the pipeline configured to provide docker creds?

ryan: i'm in the GitHub org but i haven't been added to any package teams (no idea those existed). the pipeline shows an env DOCKER_AUTH reference but it's empty.

olivia: ah — packages are gated. i'll add you to infra-packages. also the Buildkite setup relies on a pipeline secret DOCKER_AUTH (base64 docker config) so the agent can pull private images.

sam: i can push a tiny change to the pipeline to fallback to public base if DOCKER_AUTH is missing, but better to set the secret. short term: run the job manually on a local agent with your docker creds or i can add the secret for you.

ryan: thanks. quick question: is the Buildkite <-> GitHub App installed on this repo? i noticed my PR status didn't show the build.

olivia: good call — it wasn't installed on the starter repo for some reason, so check_runs weren't being reported back. i just installed the Buildkite GitHub App on redwood-internal/starter. that should make the PR show statuses.

sam: two action items: (1) olivia add ryan to infra-packages (done), (2) sam will add DOCKER_AUTH to the pipeline secrets and kick a new run.

buildkite-bot: Job 8573 queued by sam

ryan: reran the pipeline after the secret was added — image pull succeeded and steps are running. all green so far, thanks :raised_hands: 

olivia: awesome — i'll add a small onboarding note under eng-infra/ci-onboarding.md about GHCR access + pipeline DOCKER_AUTH env for new hires so this doesn't trip others.

ryan: perfect. appreciate the quick help — grabbing coffee for the rescue team :)
